title: Bucket index
description: Integers are grouped into consecutive buckets of equal size: bucket 0 holds 0 to width-1, bucket 1 holds width to 2*width-1, bucket -1 holds -width to -1, bucket -2 holds -2*width to -width-1, and so on. Return the index of the bucket that holds value. width is always positive. The index is the quotient value / width rounded down toward negative infinity.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states floor semantics (round toward negative infinity) in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
